channel.title: Finance
channel.description: Latest investing news and finance headlines straight from Wall Street.

item.title: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
item.description: The chairman both explained this week's decision to raise interest rates, and raised vexing questions about what comes next

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
item.description: Buffett's son Howard will replace him as chairman, as dictated by a long-standing succession plan, Berkshire said.

item.title: Securitize jumps after regulators greenlight some tokenized U.S. stock trading
item.description: Securitize surged Thursday after federal regulators greenlit the issuing of tokenized stocks on some trading platforms in the U.S.

item.description: Rhodium Group's latest analysis of Chinese and U.S. AI companies also found that low revenue did not necessarily correspond with lower valuation.

item.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday approved its first interest rate hike since 2023 and indicated another to come.

item.title: Senate is still a toss-up, but Democrats now have slight edge, prediction market traders think
item.description: Traders on both Kalshi and Polymarket see Democrats with one of their best chances to flip the U.S. Senate since the contracts on the election opened.

item.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
item.description: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.

item.title: China's August retail sales miss forecast while investment slump deepens, piling pressure on Beijing
item.description: China's investment slump deepened, retail sales growth slowed further in August while industrial output blew past estimates as Beijing warns of supply-demand imbalance.

item.title: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide
item.description: The muted outlook from the country's second-largest bank by assets could be an early signal that Wall Street's AI boom might have hit turbulence.

item.title: Warsh's credibility is on the line this week as Trump policies put pressure on Fed to hike
item.description: With inflation above target and no visibility on lower oil prices or stability of tariffs, the Fed chairman needs to pass the test that has faced his predecessors

item.title: Prediction market traders think gas prices will hit new highs for the year
item.description: Oil prices have marched higher in recent weeks, above $100 per barrel, as tensions between the U.S. and Iran have escalated again.

item.title: China says AI CEOs' call for a slowdown is 'fear mongering'
item.description: Chinese state media's reports of the daily press conference also noted that all groups should work together for AI openness and inclusivity.

item.title: Prediction markets are becoming more professionalized, but also harder to beat
item.description: The institutionalization of prediction markets threatens to erode the edge of skilled traders who earn off mispricing and market inefficiencies, experts say.

item.title: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season
item.description: The 2025 football season and 2024 presidential election pushed prediction markets into the prominence they enjoy today.

item.title: Inflation is outpacing wage growth again, squeezing Americans’ paychecks
item.description: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.

item.title: A Chinese humanoid startup flips 'distillation' claim on OpenAI as it releases a new robotics model
item.description: Ant-backed startup JoyIn's CEO published an article in Chinese that raised questions about similarities between his company's new model and OpenAI publications.

item.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test
item.description: Chinese netizens focused on the price of Apple’s iPhone Duo, as cheaper Xiaomi and Huawei foldables raise value comparisons and muddle the foldable's reception.

item.title: OpenAI targets work of Wall Street junior bankers with new ChatGPT for Financial Services
item.description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, targeting the labor-intensive research, modeling and pitchbook tasks traditionally handled by junior bankers.

item.title: Kalshi launches ‘perps’ for gold and silver following CFTC approval, expanding futures offerings
item.description: Its the latest move by the prediction market company to diversify its assets users can trade.

item.title: Ant International partners with Visa, Mastercard on developing AI payments
item.description: Visa, Mastercard and Ant International are working on common standards for AI-agent payments — including ways to verify and monitor their transactions.

item.title: Adani Enterprises shares jump as airport unit enters into $1 billion fundraising deal
item.description: The investors will subscribe to new shares in three tranches and collectively own about 5.54% of the airport operator after the final tranche.

item.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
item.description: As Chinese electric car sales slow and share prices tumble, several of the automakers are ramping up humanoid robotics development.

item.title: How one hedge-fund manager built his firm to be powered entirely by AI agents

item.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges

item.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks

item.title: China says it will pump $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
item.description: With a bigger capital cushion, financial institutions may also be asked to do more to mobilize resources in capital markets, analysts say.

item.title: Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here
